name: aqg-startup-preflight
description: Run a one-time SESSION START preflight before repository work by verifying worktree state, dirty git, behind remote/upstream fetch health, required context files, recent commits, and GitHub PR/issue visibility; surface blockers before the first edit. Supports multi-repo, offline/no-GitHub modes, and advisory checks for stale STACK_STATUS, CODE_MAP, and concurrent worktrees.

sentence_patterns: Run the AQG preflight before I edit anything
Check worktree + GitHub state at session start
Verify the repo is clean before I start coding
Run an offline startup preflight without GitHub checks
Check required context files and concurrent worktrees before changes
我刚开 session, 先看下 worktree 干净吗

cli_contract.1: reserved — surfacing blocker is in output, not exit code
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: I just opened a session and am about to change code — first check whether the worktree is clean

Before I start, check whether there are open PRs/issues on GitHub that might interfere
